summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 earnings press release, MD&A, and interim financial statements. The filing reports record operational and financial results: revenue of $97M (up 151% YoY), net income of $35M, and cash of $183M. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.) is announced; the disclosure is routine periodic reporting. The filing includes certifications and standard corporate updates such as a Nasdaq listing and board appointments. This is an ordinary earnings report, not a special situation.
